title: Content Information Fields
content: # **Objective** Learn about Content Information Fields in CLO-SET and how to effectively utilize the feature. 1. What is Content Information Field? 2. Field Management * Default Fields * Custom Fields * *Number Type Fields 3. Permission # # **Detail** ### **1) What is Content Information Field?** * The Content Field is where information about the Content is stored. Users can customize the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). Start storing Content information in CLO-SET to elevate your asset management flow. * Content Fields are tailored for each Content Type. Fields used can only be managed by Company Admin and Group Operator. To start adding custom fields, read the instructions below. ##### **[New Content Page]** Within the **Overview section** , you can quickly review the following 5 key information:![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808256372377) **1) Thumbnail Image & Content Field** \- Workflow Status, Score, Content ID, External No. External ID, Content type, Creator, Create Date **2) General** \- Material composition, Customer Type, Color, Price, MOQ, Category, Tag, Description **3) File Version** \- Total Version, Recent Version **4) Linked Content** \- Parent Content, Child Content **5) Setting** \- You can freely configure and customize the content information displayed in the Overview section. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808256379033) **[Legacy Content Page]** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55009085377561) ### ### 2) Field Management **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778881725081) * Before inputting information on the Content, we recommend that you review the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). * To add/edit Content Fields for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), visit [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873). * Click on 'Content' > 'Information' to view the list of Content Types and Fields used. * Content Fields are shared and applied to all Contents within the [Company](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). #### **1\. Default Fields** * Default Fields can NOT be added or deleted. You can change the name, values, and unit format. * CLO-SET Provides tailored Defaults Fields for each Content Type. * For example, for Style type Contents, there are 6 Default Fields - material composition, customer type, color, price, MOQ, and date. * To edit the name, value, or unit format, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. On the Edit modal, edit the details and click 'Save'. * ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778943746585) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778912589465) ---|--- #### **2\. Custom Fields** * Custom Fields are fully customizable. Can create up to 16 Custom Fields per Content Type. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778912761113) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778904421913) ---|--- * To add a Custom Field, start by clicking the 'Add Custom Field' button. * Fill in the name and select the 'Type' of the field to be used. Fill in values or unit information when applicable, and click 'Save' to create the Custom Field. * Field Types provided are listed below. Once the field is saved, field type **CANNOT** be changed. * Text (up to 100 characters) * Textbox (up to 1000 characters) * Number (in unit format) * Date (in calendar format) * Dropdown: single-selection * Checkbox: multi-selection allowed * To **edit** the Custom Field, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. Changing the field details will impact the existing field information. * To **delete** the Custom Field, hover over the field row and click the trash button. Deleting the field will impact the existing field information, and the data stored will no longer be available. #### **3\. 'Number' Type Fields** **Unit Options** | **Currency Options for Price** | **Unit Format Example** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778913205657) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778904807833) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778916815001) * When editing the 'Number' type fields, you have an option to customize the unit format. * Please refer to the table below for placeholders used to customize the unit format. **Placeholder** | **Explanation** ---|--- 0 | The number of digits. Insignificant zeros are displayed in the result # | The number of digits. Meaningless zeros will not appear in the result . (decimal point) | Format numbers with decimal separators , (rest) | Specifies a thousands separator in a number ### ### 3) Permission * Field Management: by Group Admin or Company Admin at Company Settings page * Input/View Content Information: All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit field information. Viewers are read only
content_description: This web page aims to educate users on the Content Information Fields feature in CLO-SET, detailing its purpose, management options, and customizable capabilities for enhanced asset management.

title: Content Details
content: # **Objective** You can edit the detail on each Content. Manage Content information to be reflected on Tech Pack, Line Sheet, etc. 1. Content Details 2. Permission # **Detail** ### 1) Content Details ##### **[New Content Page]** On the **Overview tab** , which is the main entry of the Content Page, you can view key information about the content at a glance. The Overview tab is structured into the following sections: **Overview, Details, Version, Linked Content, and 3D Quality Check**. Within the **Overview section** , you can quickly review the following 5 key information:![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808129330585) **1) Thumbnail Image & Content Field** \- Workflow Status, Score, Content ID, External No. External ID, Content type, Creator, Create Date **2) General** \- Material composition, Customer Type, Color, Price, MOQ, Category, Tag, Description **3) File Version** \- Total Version, Recent Version **4) Linked Content** \- Parent Content, Child Content **5) Setting** \- You can freely configure and customize the content information displayed in the Overview section. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808145883033) More detailed information about the content can be accessed by clicking the **Details, Version, Linked Content,****** and******3D Quality Check** tabs.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808129334681) **[Legacy Content Page]** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55005930830489) 1. [**Content Type**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801)**:** zpac/zprj files are auto-identified as Style. You may choose the Content Type when uploading the file. 2. **Content Name:** Used throughout CLO-SET features including Line Sheet, Tech Pack, etc. You may edit the Content Name anytime by double-clicking on the field. 3. [**Linked Content**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303217993881)**/**[**Notification**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303197105177)**/**[**Favorite**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153) : * Linked Content: You can easily check the list of Parent/Child Contents. * Notification/Favorite: Click the bell icon to turn on the notification of this Content. You may also add this to your Favorite list. 4. [**Workflow**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241)**:** Shows the Workflow of each Content. You may change the Workflow anytime using the drop-down menu. Workflow names can be customized on [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. 5. [**Content ID**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) * Content ID: Unique ID auto-created by CLO-SET and can NOT be edited. You may search the Content using Content ID. * Thumbnail: Thumbnail images are extracted from the original 3D file when applicable. 6. [**Score**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303244420889) : Score rating of the Content. A numerical value from 1 to 10. 7. [**Category**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049)**:** Add Content Category to easily search and manage the files. You may customize your Category names and hierarchy on [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. This will be reflected on your Tech Pack and Line Sheet. 8. **Tags** : Insert Tags on your Content. This will be reflected on your Tech Pack and Line Sheet. 9. **Description** : Enter additional description. This will be reflected on your Tech Pack. 10. [**Content Information Fields**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617) : Click 'More information' and add more information (material composition / customer type / color / Price / MOQ / Date). Manage Content information with customizable fields for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). Fields can be added/edited in [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873) ##### **Tips) Tag Recommendation** 1. **Auto-complete for Existing Tags** When entering a tag on the Content Page, the system now provides an auto-complete function that suggests existing tags. ex) Typing **“Leat”** will automatically suggest **“Leather.”** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54775494821529) 2\. **Recommendation of 5 Recently Used Tags** Even before entering a tag, up to five tags will be recommended based on the following criteria: \- Among the tags registered under the same Company as the Content being tagged, \- The five most recently used tags by the same user will be suggested. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54775494822553) 💡 **Note** > If any of the suggested tags have already been applied, they will be replaced by the next most recently used tags. ### 2) Permission **Permission** : All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit Content Details / Viewers are read only
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for managing and editing content details for Tech Packs and Line Sheets, providing users with easy access to key information, customization options, and permission settings.

Render - How To 2. Crop Option in Render Setting 3. Rendering Server Status 4. Render Preset 5. Render in CLO vs CLO-SET # **Details** ### 1) Render - How To * In the Content page, click the Render icon (![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808100314649)) on the left pane to start, and the Render Settings tab will open on the right pane. * Select the options as per needed, and **click 'Render'****** to create Render (_Learn more about_[ _Render Settings_](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207203225)) > _**Render on the Content Page**_
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808100315673)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808113698329)
> > * In **New** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808100318105)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808100319257)
> > * Once you click **Render** , you may leave the page. When rendering is complete, a **render thumbnail** will appear in the **Viewer options list** on the **Content page**. > _**Render View on the Content Page**_
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808113701273)
> > * In **New** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808100321049)
> > ### 2) Crop Option in Rendering Setting * crops to the nearest 5 pixels of the 3D content,_regardless of what is shown in the 3D Viewer_ * works both in transparent and colored background * Style Page > Render > Rendering Settings > Background > Crop * You must uncheck the 'Use Software settings' before applying the Crop option ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778676720025) In order to properly use the 'Crop' option, **the 3D content needs to be placed within the darkened frame shown inside the 3D Viewer.** Although the darkened frame does not reflect the cropped frame when the Crop option in clicked, _the 3D content is first cropped by the darkened frame_. Thus, if the 3D Content sits outside of the darkened frame, the render will be cropped. For example, if the render is triggered as shown below on the left, the result will be as the following on the right. ![Screenshot_2023-01-27_at_9.15.27_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778709349145) | ► | ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778724565657) ---|---|--- Final Render output shown below. ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778694043673) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778740992665) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778678578073) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778694926361) ### 3) Rendering Server Status 'CLO-SET Rendering Server Status' is a feature that allows users to be more aware of their rendering status with the information of server status and their current orders in the rendering queues. Find out more details on [THIS ARTICLE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303263040921). ### 4) Render Preset For a unified Render output, you may upload a Render Preset for your Company members. Find out more [here](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129). ### 5) Render in CLO vs CLO-SET Basically, V-Ray's CPU and GPU rendering don't produce identical results. CLO and CLO-SET both use [Vray Rendering.](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115003861567-V-Ray-Render) However, CLO-SET only supports GPU rendering, whereas CLO supports both GPU and CPU rendering. The results of the GPU render of CLO and the render of CLO-SET are consistent. But, as CPU and GPU rendering results differ, you cannot expect to see the same results between the CLO CPU and CLO-SET GPU rendering results. We suggest the following workflow. Select the device before starting the rendering task and generate the final output. Choose either one of the workflow. > Utilizing GPU rendering in CLO and CLO-SET. > Utilizing CPU rendering in CLO. Unfortunately, attempting to synchronize the CPU and GPU is impossible. ### • Update in Render Settings (Feb 2024) The **default** **background setting** has been updated to match your Render Settings in CLO3D. You may choose to disable the option to customize the Render background in CLO-SET. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778722895257)

```
Error: Unexpected Error has occurred. Please check your file.
``` For this error message, considering checking below: * **Issue: Converting incomplete** * Please try again once the Content converting is complete. Render cannot be initiated while converting is in process. For newly uploaded files, this may take up to 3 minutes. If the converting failed, please contact us with the content page URL for support. * **Issue: Render size too big** * Width & height of the requested Render must be equal or less than 5000px. * **Issue: Invalid File Type** * Rendering is available for 3D files only. * Rendering is not supported for Blank Contents. Check [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) * **Issue: Missing mandatory information from the API request** * Preset ZVRP information missing. When uzeZVRP=true, then presetSeq field is mandatory. * Render Setting information is mandatory. Check the renderableScene field. * Invalid parameters. Requested Item Version cannot be set as 0. * Check Group information. The requested Group does not exist, or the user is not the member of the requested Group. * Check Render Preset. The requested presetSeq does not exist. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777930549273)

title: Supported File Formats in 3D Viewer
content: # **Objective** Learn about supported file formats in CLO-SET 3D Viewer. 1. [File Format](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153968537) # **Details** ### 1) File Format **Type** | **Format** | **Description** ---|---|--- Garment | *.zpac | Contains information on garments, patterns, sewing, and fabrics. Project | *.zprj | Compressed version of multiple files used for garment creation. The Project file contains the AVT file that has avatar-related data (Avatar, Accessories, Arrangement Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points, Avatar size, Poses), the ZPac file that contains garment-related data (3D Garments, 2D Patterns, Fabrics, subsidiary Material), as well as an animation file if there is any. Avatar | *.avt, .avte | Contains all the information related to Avatars (Model, Sizing data, Poses, Motions, Accessories, Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points). OBJ | *.obj | Contains geometry and material information. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. GL Transmission Format | *gltf / glb | Contains scene and material information using the JSON standard. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. COLLADA | *.dae | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya, Pose, and DAZ Studio. These files contain geometry and material information, as well as rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting COLLADA files from 3ds Max or Maya, install “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org/download.html](http://www.opencollada.org/download.html)) and export to use the avatar Fabric | *.zfab | Contains the property values (texture + physical properties) of the set fabric. Button | *.btn | Contains the type, size, and color of Buttons. Buttonhole | *.bth | Contains the type, size, and color of the Buttonholes. Trim | *.trm | Contains material information Zipper Puller | *.zpl | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Pullers. Zipper Slider | *.zsd | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Sliders. Zipper Stopper | *.zsp | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Stoppers. CAD file | *.dxf | Contains 2D CAD pattern and grading data. Used to import garment patterns from external CAD systems into CLO.
content_description: Discover the various supported file formats in CLO-SET 3D Viewer, essential for effective garment design and project management.

(When you click **Add Colorway** , the **Save** button appears.) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54906987617305) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54906987621401) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54906998764569) ---|---|--- 4\. title: New Configurator
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193164697)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776177016345)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776224902169)Editor # **Objective** Learn how to use the New Configurator in CLO-SET 1. Requirements 2. Configurator UI 3. Color * Color Switch 4. Basic Parameters * Auto-generate Normal Map 5. Reflection 6. Graphic Editor 7. Save/Add Colorway 8. Troubleshooting # # **Details** ### **Learn about the New Configurator from the CLO-SET Team!** ### 1) Requirements Compatibility: Zprj/Zpac files saved on CLO 2024.1.244 or above ### 2) Configurator UI ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800842786713) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800749573657) 1. **Object Browser** * View the list of objects used on the garment. Select an object to edit. 2. **Save/Add Colorway** * 'Save': edits made will be saved to the current selected Colorway. Only available for Configurator-created Colorways. * 'Add': edits made will be saved as a new Colorway 3. **Colorway List** * List of Colorways (from original file & created via CLO-SET Configurator) 4. **Tool Bar** * Switch between 'Select' and 'Edit Texture' tool * ![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305) Select object to be edited * ![Icon Pack \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776177664665) Edit Texture to zoom in/out or move the applied texture with a Gizmo tool. *Using the 'Edit Texture' will edit all 6 maps in Basic Parameters and Reflection. To edit each parameters separately, please use the Basic Parameters tab to input specific values. 5. **Property Editor** * Edit material property including Color, Basic Parameters, and Reflection. ***Please Note** : New Colorways created with New Configurator are **NOT** editable on the conventional [Configurator](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303180764313). ### 3) Color 1\. To start, select an object from your garment (![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305)) 2\. Click on 'Color' tab to start editing. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776185951257) 3\. Choose the color to be applied to the selected pattern **Picker** | **PANTONE** | **coloro** ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2024-07-02 at 5.16.01 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776186110489) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-02 at 10.53.05 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776209735193) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-02 at 10.53.20 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776209927705) * **Picker** : select the color to apply from the color picker, and click 'Find' below to find similar PANTONE color chips. Users may select from HEX/RGB/HSL options to input the color code. * **PANTONE** : select a color chip to be applied. Use the drop-down list for PANTONE palettes. * **coloro** : select a color chip to be applied. Search using the color name * **Custom** : select a color chip from your [custom palette](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303194294425) 4\. Use the '< (Back)' button to edit other material properties, or click 'Reset' to reset the properties. *Please note the the 'Reset' option will reset all properties including Color, Texture, and Reflection. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776186733721) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776210290969) ### [Color Switch] Color Switch prepares the solid fabric for a smooth transition to the newly selected color, ensuring it is applied accurately and seamlessly. * Learn about the Color Switch feature in [**CLO 2024.2**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Materials#01J8J0B16SJ6HJCMDVGKG9XNFB)![Switch Color.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776244377753) * **How To:** Open the [New Configurator](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303181526297), and select an object to start * From the right pane, click 'Base Color Map' tab * Below the Base Color Map, you will find the 'Color Switch' option * Please note that you can ONLY use either Desaturation or Color Switch, not both. When one is turned off, the other can be activated * Once the 'Color Switch' is turned on explore new colorways by changing the Color or Opacity * Color Switch and Desaturation can be used for all types of objects, except for button hole.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800746598041) ### 4) Basic Parameters 1\. To start, select an object from your garment (![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305)) 2\. Click on 'Basic Parameters' tab to start editing. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776185951257) 3\. Choose the maps to be applied to the selected pattern **Texture** | **Normal Map** | **Displacement Map** | **Opacity Map** ---|---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776211068953) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-03 at 5.20.11 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776227613209) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-03 at 5.20.32 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776188104985) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-03 at 5.20.46 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776211571353) * Basic Parameters works the same as in CLO's Property Editor. Learn more [**HERE**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures). * Select the parameter to edit * Upload, delete, or download a new map to be applied * Type in specific number fields to adjust the parameters in detail * *Opacity can be applied without the Opacity Map, and will be applied to the whole fabric. To apply opacity to selective parts of the fabric, please upload an opacity map. 4\. Use the '< (Back)' button to edit other material properties, or click 'Reset' to reset the properties. *Please note the the 'Reset' option will reset all properties including Color, Texture, and Reflection. ### [Auto-generate Normal Map] CLO-SET will auto-generate a Normal Map based on the Base Color Map for objects that have only the Base Color Map applied and no Normal Map available. * **Conditions** : Normal Map will be generated ONLY when the selected object meets ALL of below * has Base Color Map * does NOT have normal map * user adjusts Normal Map Intensity to a non-zero value ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776196960025) | ▶ | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776197087001) ---|---|--- * Deleting the base color map of the object will also delete the normal map.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776197384985) * The auto-generated normal maps will be deactivated when the Intensity is set back to 0.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776198025497) ### 5) Reflection 1\. To start, select an object from your garment (![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305)) 2\. Click on 'Reflection' tab to start editing ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776185951257) 3\. Adjust the Reflection. Reflection works the same as in CLO's Property Editor. Learn more [**HERE**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures). * Reflection has 2 properties - Roughness and Metalness * Roughness can be edited in 2 modes - Intensity & Roughness Map ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776214709657) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776246790169) * **Intensity** : Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness * **Roughness Map** : Edit fabric gloss by adding/modifying Roughness Map * Metalness can be applied without the Metalness Map, and will be applied to the whole fabric. To apply metalness to selective parts of the fabric, please upload a Metalness map. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776256678809) ### 6) Graphic Editor * **Select** : Click on the graphic directly, or select the graphic from the object browser. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800746607385) * **Edit** : Click and drag the Gizmo to adjust the Graphic: ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800749591193) * Triangle ▲ \- Uniform scale, adjust **width & length** in fixed ratio * Outer Circle ⦿ \- Rotate the angle of graphic * Inner Circle • \- Changes the position of graphic * **Change** : Select the graphic and click 'Basic Parameters' from the right pane. * Download: download the graphic file currently in use * Change: upload a new graphic to replace current graphic ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800749597977) * **Graphic Requirements** * Graphic properties must meet below requirements to use CLO-SET Graphic Editor: * Tile = None * Over Seamline = Off ![mceclip1 \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262742103577). ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262746458649) * If not met, Graphics will be marked ❌ from the object browser, and you can only adjust the Color of the graphic in CLO-SET. Please make changes on the .zprj/.zpac file from CLO3D software. ### 7) Save/Add Colorway ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776198953113) * When editing is complete, click _**'Add Colorway**_ ' to create a new Configurator-created Colorway. All new Colorways created in CLO-SET will have the purple water drop icon on the Thumbnail. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776247252377) * Users cannot overwrite the Colorways from original file. Edits made can only be saved as a new Colorway (with purple water drop icon). * Configurator-created Colorways (with purple water drop icon) can be edited/saved on CLO-SET. ***Please Note** : New Colorways created with New Configurator are **NOT** editable on the conventional [Configurator](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303180764313). ### 8) Troubleshooting * Compatibility: to use Configurator, please use a desktop or laptop. Any monitors with resolutions below 800 cannot use Configurator * Per the object type, there may be limitations to which parameters can be adjusted. Such restrictions will be disabled per the user's object selection. * For example, you can only edit the Color of Graphic. Basic Parameters and Reflection will be disabled.

title: Global Unit Setting (Measurement & Currency)
content:
## **Objective** Understand Global Unit (Measurement & Currency) Setting. 1. What is Global Unit Setting 2. Managing global unit inconsistencies 3. Default Currency in Web Tech Pack / Content Page / Linesheet ## ## **Details** #### **1) What is Global Unit Setting?** Global Unit setting is an unified management of currency & measurement units at the company level. * From the left pane, click Browse > Company, then go to Settings ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54985562648601) | | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54985578474009) ---|---|--- * In Settings, you can configure the Global Unit (Measurement & Currency) on the General Tab. It applies to the 2D Pattern Viewer and is synchronized with the Content Custom Field (Length) and Web Tech Pack (BOM, POM, and Cost Estimation tabs). ![ddd.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47495014053529)💡 **Note** > Global Unit Setting is applied at the company level.
> > User with **'Company Admin'** or '**Group Admin'** permission can modify these options. #### **2) Managing Global Unit Inconsistency** If the unit set in Company Settings differs from the unit of the file, a Modal will appear, indicating which unit is different. This modal is displayed in the following four cases: 1\. Mismatch when versioning up file 2\. Mismatch when uploading file 3\. Mismatch when updating tech pack version 4\. Mismatch when adding BOM item to the table #### **3) Unit Synchronization** Unit set in Company Settings is synchronized across various domains in CLO-SET. In the Web Tech Pack, the Global Unit is synchronized and displayed in the **"Overview"** , "**BOM"** and **"Cost Estimation"** tabs. 1\. Web Tech Pack Unit Synchronization Measurement Unit and Price Unit data are synchronized and displayed, with the price unit shown as the **"default currency"** in the top right corner. ![111.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519362877721) If the price unit differs, both the **"default currency"** and the **"file currency"** are displayed simultaneously in the top right corner. ![222.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519362878233) ![17.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519878308633) 2\. The default currency is also displayed on the 'Content Page' and the 'Linesheet'. [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799846076313)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799846078617) [Legacy Content Page]![ㅁㅇㄹㅇㅁㄴㄹ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519868822297) [Linesheet] ![ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519878310809)

title: Web Tech Pack ▶ Measurement
content: #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778435945113) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778420616473) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778471293593) Editor # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778436659225) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- On the Measurement tab, you can view the POM information for 2D, 3D, and set Target information. [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799525594905) [Legacy POM of WTP] ## **![Measurement.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778436931353)** 1. POM Information 2. 3D Viewer 3. Setting 4. Version 5. Create Blank POM # **Details** ### 1) POM Information POM info shown on WTP is from the data stored in your 3D file from CLO 3D. * Create POM Measurement in CLO3D. Once you create 2D POM, 3D POM will be auto-generated. > [• How to create POM](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025716774-Create-POM) > [• Edit POM](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025716814-Edit-POM-ver5-1-0-) > [• POM List](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025716854-POM-LIST) > [• Grading/Base Size](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000742668-Grading) ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.04.23 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778437318809) * Once you upload the .zprj / .zpac file, CLO-SET will import this data to WTP-Measurement. * You can add Target Measurement guidelines of Tolerance and HTM Comment and collaborate with partners to make the garment fit the designer's purposes and standards. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.08.02 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778472589209) ### 2) 3D Viewer ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.14.27 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778488213913) | * View your garment in 3D on the left pane. * Select viewing option from the Tool Bar: * Turn Avatar on/off * Turn Garment on/off * Schematic Render * Background Color * Selected POM from the table will be highlighted on the 3D Viewer in red line ---|--- ### 3) Setting * Click on ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778488507417) icon on the top right corner to manage Measurement Preferences. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.18.52 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778488741913) | * Select Measurement Type you want to view. Both the 2D/3D POM data is exported from your .zprj / .zpac file * Select Measurement Unit: Inch / cm / mm ---|--- ### 4) Version When you upload a new version of the Content, information on Measurement tab is also updated. To view the older Version, you may select from the drop-down menu. [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799507306265) [Legacy POM of WTP] ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.23.10 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778473826329) ### ### 5) Create Blank POM **1) When the content is blank** * In **WTP → Measurement** tab, a guide message appears: **“Create Draft POM.”**(Click POM tab in the new content page) ![Group 1005.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782607142169)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799525600025) * Click the button to generate a **blank Measurement Table**. [New Content Page]![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799525601433) [Legacy POM of WTP] ![Group 1009.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782579110681) * Click the button to generate a **blank Measurement Table**. ![Group 1007.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782607157401) * Double-click each column to enter data: **POM, Description, HTMComment, Tolerance, Target**. * Right-click a **row** to open the context menu and **Add Row / Delete Row**. * Right-click a **Size** **column** to open the context menu and **Add Column / Set Base / Delete Column**. * **Note:** For blank content, the **3D viewer is not available**. **2) When the content has no Measurement Data** * Click the button to generate a**Measurement Table**. ![Group 1009.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782579110681) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799525601433) * Double-click each column to enter data: **POM, Description, HTMComment, Tolerance, Target**. ![Group 1012.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782579117849) * If the file is a **3D file** , the **3D viewer** appears on the **left**. * Right-click a **row** to open the context menu and **Add Row / Delete Row**. * Right-click a size**column** to open the context menu and **Add Size Column /****Set Base** for the size column (base for grading) **3) Version update policy** Version updates follow the same rules as the **BOM** table: * The update is based on the **latest WTP file**. * **Items added** in the **previous version** are **carried over** to the new version. * Carried-over items are **listed at the bottom** of the table. * **Duplicate entries cannot be automatically distinguished**. * After the version update, **editing the previous version is disabled**.

For example, to add a material under Fabric, the uploaded file must be in zfab format and identified as Fabric[ Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) in CLO-SET. * User must have 'Editor' or above [permission](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537) to the Workroom to which the original Content (to be added as Material) is saved. * When adding a material from CLO-SET, it will load the latest version that matches the file format. * Version updates on the Trim files will NOT be reflected to the WTP automatically. If needed, please delete the old material and add it again. * If the Trim file is deleted in CLO-SET, the BOM table will mark the material as 'deleted'. *Content Type can be selected upon upload. > > _The Color chip that you see is the color chip of Fabric_
> > _If there are several fabrics, you will see the very first one on the top of the list._
> > _If you would like to switch around the order, you can simply drag and sort the order in CLO3D._ > > ![Newsletter_Scrapbook_-_Frame_15.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992281033113) ### 5) WTP Version Update * When you upload a [new version](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) of the Style Content, you have an option to update the WTP * If you upload a file format other than .zprj/.zpac as a new version to a[ Style Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), * New WTP information will be reflected on BOM / Construction / Measurement / Cost Estimation. * Once you click 'UPDATE', the Style information in Web Tech Pack will be updated. * If you accidentally press the 'CANCEL' button, you must re-upload the same file. Cancelling cannot be undone. * What does an 'update' mean in Web Tech Pack? * If new materials were added to the project file, the new materials will be added to the BOM * If the existing materials have been updated from the software, the updates will be reflected to the new version of the Web Tech Pack * If you have deleted any material on the previous versions of the Web Tech Pack, the new version will EXCLUDE the deleted materials, even if it is included on the new project file uploaded. * Version updates on the Trim files registered on the BOM is NOT reflected automatically * Editing the Web Tech Pack information manually can only be done on the latest WTP version * Once you update the Web Tech Pack version, deleting the new version file from the Content Page will NOT delete the corresponding WTP version. You will be able to review the data, but the WTP will be marked as 'deleted'. _**💡 Notes**_ > _BOM and POM information for garment content can be view directly on the content page without navigating to a separate page._

content: # **Objective** ### Understand how to use the **AI Studio - Graphic Generator** on CLO-SET. 1. ##### What is AI STUIDO - Graphic Generator 2. ##### How to Use the Graphic Generator in CLO-SET # **Details** ### 1) What is AI Studio - Graphic Generator? AI Studio – Graphic Generator generates customizable graphic images from text-based prompts. By simply typing in keywords (or uploading image), you can create unique graphics that can be applied directly to your 3D garments and patterns. > Note : AI Studio (Graphic Generator) is only supported on the legacy Content Page. #### **[Generate]** 1. You can choose either the **Text** or **Image** option in the AI Graphic Generator.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784829209) 2. Set options, enter prompts (or upload image), and click the Generate button.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946777066777) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784841113) **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Content Type** | Select the type of content. Generate embroidery graphics from simple keyword prompts, or instantly transform uploaded images into embroidery-style visuals. **Transparent Background** | Apply a transparent background to the image.**This option is not available for the Pop Art type.** **Text Prompt** | Enter the prompts. **✨ Writing Tips:** * **List the words.** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. * **Emphasize certain words more.** If parentheses are used in the word you want to emphasize, it takes up more weight.Parentheses on certain words take more weight. Weight increase rate : (word) 1.1 times, ((word)) 1.21 times. **![Frame 247.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784844825)** **Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Graphic image is created newly each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as possible. It may differ from the existing results depending on the addition or change of the prompts. **Random** | The sample prompt is randomly applied. #### **[Apply]** 1. Click the Apply button below when the AI Texture is completely generated. → If you apply it, the result will be uploaded as a **new version**. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946777077785) ##### **📝Note:** It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. ### 2) Using the Graphic Generator in CLO-SET 1. Upload content from AI Studio Click the _**New**_**** button in the workroom and select _**Upload from AI Studio**_. Image content can be generated instantly using the**Graphic Generator** within the workroom space. ![Group 1050.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784853273) 2. AI Studio in Blank Content In the workroom, click the _**New**_ button and select _**Create Blank Content**_. After choosing a content type, click the _**Try Uploading from AI Studio**_ button on the blank content page to instantly generate image content using the Graphic Generator.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52948952725529)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52997568312601) 3. Version Upload with AI Studio _**Version upload**_ can also be performed using _**AI Studio Graphic Generator**_ when uploading a new version within the content page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52997568316697) **📝Note:** The AI Studio Graphic Generator feature is available only on paid plans. AI Studio for CLO-SET Enterprise is not yet available. ####

CLO-SET will automatically check the uploaded CLO file properties per the standards setup by the Admin and mark the result for the team to view. * Quality Check standards can be set for each Company within the Group. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56797432759065) ### 2) Setup Quality Check **Permission** : ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873) Group Admin, Company Admin * To start using the feature, your Company must have a 3D Quality Check standards setup by the Admin. This can be done on the [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/articles/45303214894873) page. * In Company Settings, click Content > 3D Quality Check. Then, click the activate toggle. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776272087961) * For more details on how to input the properties and what each property refers to in CLO, please[ download the PDF guideline.](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49715354278809) [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776275644441)](https://support.clo-set.com/guide-media/01JR7CPDFB3DKX4HT02CFREMYD) | [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776283678233)](https://support.clo-set.com/guide-media/01JR7CPDFB3DKX4HT02CFREMYD) ---|--- * **Please note** : updating the properties will NOT be synced to older tests. You must re-upload the file to apply the new standards. ### 3) Quality Check in Content Page Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor [Legacy Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776274210073)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271643417) | [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56797423081369)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56797432757913) ---|--- * Once the Quality Check is activated and setup, it will be applied to the newly uploaded files. * Click the red 'QC' icon to view the full test result. * **Please Note** : Quality Check runs only once for all versions. Re-upload the file to run the quality check again. * The 'QC' label will be displayed on the latest version uploaded. To review the QC for older versions, click the ••• menu and select '3D Quality Check' option as displayed below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776324372377) ### ### 4) Quality Check Results Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor * A new tab will open with the full test result. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56797423094297) 1. Category of the property 2. Property setup in Company Settings 3. Criteria setup in Company Settings 4. Test result: Passed 5. Test result: Failed, click the list icon for the list of materials that failed the test 6. Test result: N/A. Property not included in the checklist 7. Select to only view the properties that failed the test * **Please note** : Updating or editing the 3D file should be done in CLO. Also, Quality Check runs only once for all versions. Re-upload the file to run the quality check again. ### 5) Supported File Formats * Compatible with all file types supported in 3D Viewer, as of Dec 2024. * More specifically, 3D Quality Check is compatible with the file extensions listed below: * zpac, zprj, avt, obj, fbx, dae, glb, grp, zfab, zmod, trm, btn, bth, zpl, zsd, zse, zsp, zpu, zsl, zst, zss, sst, zacs, pos, hpos

You may also easily run Render or generate Excel Tech Pack via CLO-SET. 1. Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload) 2. Render via CLO-SET 3. Tech Pack via CLO-SET **Details** ### 1) Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload) 1\. 'Share via CLO-SET' from CLO Software. **Option 1** | **Option 2** ---|--- File > Share via CLO-SET ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778354185241) | Main Menu ▶ ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778354297113) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778345303577) 2\. content:
# **Objective** Learn how to navigate CLO-SET Dashboard and utilize your Workroom Space ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992629223449) 1. Menus (Left Pane) 2. Space (Room View) 3. Comment, Share (Right Pane) 4. Content Interaction & Movement # **Details** ### 1) Menus (Left Pane) ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 1.54.49 PM copy.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777975520921) | ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 3.15.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778005716249) ---|--- **1\. Group Name** : See which Group you're currently in. To switch the Group, click on the downward arrow (⌄) next to the Group's name. The Blue Crown indicates that you are the Group Admin. **2\. Menu Tab** * Browse: View the space [hierarchy](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) and navigate to the desired Space * Workspace: View all Spaces by level. (ex. Click on 'Companies' to view all Company Space you have access to) * Console: View [Admin Console](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721) for usage data, billing, and developer page. * [Favorites](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153): View all Spaces and Contents you've marked as Favorite * [Search](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161): Search Contents using everyday words or an image. ### 2) Space (Room View) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992629224217) **3\. Space Info** * Upload: Upload a new Content in current Workroom * Create: Create a sub-Space * Notifications: Turn notifications on/off for current Space * [Favorite](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153): Mark/unmark the Space as Favorite * Navigation: Shows the hierarchy of the Space you are in **4.**[**Line Sheet**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289)** & **[**Data Intelligence**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303278347545) **5\. Space Name** : Name of the Space you are in (Brand | Workroom) **6.**[**Search Bar**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161): Search Contents within the Space **7.**[**Filter**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049)**:** Filter the Contents you want to view 8\. View by: Shows by each content or clorway ### 3)Comment, Share (Right Pane) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992573410713) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777990897561) #### **Share to People** * [**Invite/Share**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303179603481): Invite or share with teammates * Invite: for Company/Brand * Share: for Workroom/Content * **Share with Link:** Turning this option on will convert the Space to public status. Be ware of the security implications when sharing with link. * **Accessible People** : View the list of teammates with access to this Space. This may include those with access to higher-level Spaces. For example, anyone with access to a Brand will be able to view all Workroom within the Brand. _**💡 Notes**_ > Download access for link-shared content (share with link) is limited to **Group Members only**. > Anyone with the link can still **view** , but only **Group Members can download** , even when **Enable Download** is turned on. #### **Workroom Comment** * Commenting is also available at the [Workroom](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697). Please follow the hyperlink to view detailed Permissions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777999005209) ### 4)Content Interaction & Movement #### 4-1) Selection Interaction (Single Click / Double Click) CLO-SET separates **item selection** and **page navigation** to prevent unintended actions. * **Single click** → Select item * **Double click** → Open item and navigate to its page ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393864050585) _**💡 Notes**_ > In the **Workroom** , a single click also allows you to **preview key content information** without opening the content page, making it easier to review details while browsing multiple contents.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56790941711257)
> > [Content information in the new Content Page UI]
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56790941718553)
> > [Content information in the Legacy Content Page UI]
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56790934806041) #### 4-2) Basic Selection Behavior #### Single Selection **Option** | **Description** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)x2 | Double click on an item: opens the item ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)x1 | Single click on an item: selects the item * Previously selected item will be deselected **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)**x1 | Single click on empty space: deselects all items * Applied to **all areas except Assortment, Dashboard, and Visual Board** #### #### Multi Selection (Workroom only) **Option** | **Description** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880017433) | Mouse left Button Drag from empty space to select multiple items Ctrl(Cmd) +**![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)** | Add or remove items from the selection * Mac : Command / Window : Control * Previously selected items will remain selected. * Selecting an already-selected item again will deselect it. Shift + **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)** | Select a range of items * adds all items between the most recently selected item and the currently selected item to the selection. ***** Multi-selection is supported **only in the Workroom (Content area)** **📝 Note** 1. **Context Menu** * The (…) button is disabled even when an item is selected. * Even if multiple items were previously selected, the selection will be cleared and only one item will remain selected. 2. **Popover Menu** * If a Workroom is included in the selection list, all actions except _deselect_ will be disabled. #### 4-3) Drag&Drop Move for Selected Contents Once contents are selected, they can be moved more efficiently using **drag &drop** interactions. #### #### Drag into a Workroom * Single or multiple selected contents can be dragged directly into a **Workroom** * The contents will be moved to the target location ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880019609) #### #### Drag via Top Breadcrumb Navigation * Selected contents can be dragged to the **top breadcrumb navigation** * When hovering over a higher-level location, a **“+” indicator** appears, allowing the contents to be dropped and moved. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393864062361)
content_description: Discover how to effectively navigate the CLO-SET Dashboard and optimize your Workroom Space for enhanced collaboration and content management.

title: Terms & Interface
content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍 New to CLO-SET? We've got you. Scroll to learn the terms & tricks before diving in to CLO-SET. * Terms * Tree Menu * Dashboard * Content Page (Overview / Viewer / BOM &POM / Cost Estimation / Attachment / Content Analysis) # **📓 Details** ## **1\. Terms** **▶** Group (![group.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776252644761))**:** Highest space level in CLO-SET. Each user owns 1 Group (ex. A's Group) **▶** Workroom (![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776220467097))**:** Where you upload your files. Consider this a 'folder' **▶** Content (![content.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776235598105))**:** Created whenever you upload a new file. You may upload any file format (not just 3D files) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269142169) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776253480985) ---|--- ## ## **2\. Tree Menu** CLO-SET provides a pre-made space structure for easier asset management. * In each Group, there is Company ▶ Brand ▶ Line ▶ Season ▶ Workroom / Assortment ▶ Content * **Workroom**(![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776220467097)) is where you can upload your Contents * Click 'Browse' at the left to expand the tree menu to find the space you're looking for ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269142169) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55000901644569) ---|--- ## **3\. Dashboard** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54868579650841) * **Menu Pane****:** Navigate between spaces, manage settings, and search Contents. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269728281) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269920409) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776221571097) ---|---|--- * **Contents List** : Easily spot the recents Contents visited, or those with latest updated. (recent content / updated content) * **Workrooms List** : Your go-to Workrooms listed. (favorite workroom / all workroom) * **Profile & Notification**: Manage account settings and notifications. _**💡 Notes**_ > Notification Tabs : **All, Comments, Updates, Account & Billing**![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54189220286489)**Notification Types**
> > **1\. Comments** : user comments and annotations
> > \- comment, comment_delete, annotation, annotation_delete, CONNECT marketplace_feedback, CONNECT marketplace_request.
> > **2\. Updates** : work and content-related updates
> > \- upload, render, fitting convert, configurator, web techpack, visual board, move, copy, delete, workroom, state, score, share
> > **3\. Account & Billing**: account, access, and billing notices
> > \- member, news, card, connect_purchase ## ## **4\. Content Page** In the left menu pane, follow these steps: 1. Double-click the **Workroom** in the Season space and Double-click the **Content** in the Workroom. 2. You can find detailed information in the**Content Page.** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54870706694425)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54870706696089) ### **[New****Content page UI - Updated on Mar 31, 2026]** The new Content Page provides a unified content page experience. Key features such as Overview, Viewer, BOM, and Attachment will be organized into tabs, allowing you to perform design, analysis, and visualization tasks within a single page—without switching between screens. **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036252313)** #### **4-1) Overview** On the **Overview tab** , which is the main entry of the Content Page, you can view key information about the content at a glance. The Overview tab is structured into the following sections: **Overview, Details, Version, Linked Content, and 3D Quality Check**. Within the **Overview section** , you can quickly review the following 5 key information:![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036259353) **1) Thumbnail Image & Content Field** \- Workflow Status, Score, Content ID, External No. External ID, Content type, Creator, Create Date **2) General** \- Material composition, Customer Type, Color, Price, MOQ, Category, Tag, Description **3) File Version** \- Total Version, Recent Version **4) Linked Content** \- Parent Content, Child Content **5) Setting** \- You can freely configure and customize the content information displayed in the Overview section. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051549721) More detailed information about the content can be accessed by clicking the **Details, Version, Linked Content,** and**3D Quality Check** tabs.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036264985) #### **4-2) Viewer** In the **Viewer tab** , you can closely examine content in both 2D and 3D, and utilize various features to support review during the design development process. The following features are available in the Viewer tab: ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036266265) ##### **1) Viewer Type (2D / 3D / Image / Render Viewer) & Viewing Option** \- Different viewer types and viewing options are provided to support content review from multiple perspectives. 1-1) 3D Viewer : Select a 3D file to freely explore and review garment data in the Viewer. 2D Pattern Viewer : View garment pattern data in a 2D format. Image Viewer : Check thumbnail images. Render Viewer : View rendered images. 1-2) Viewing Option : Use **Viewing Options** to explore content in various view modes. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051570073) > _**💡**_ Note : View Control (Mouse Navigation)
> > **Mouse / Keyboard** | | **3D Viewer** > ---|---|--- > Roll up/down the Cursor | **![Scroll.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036269337)**| Zoom in / Zoom out > Hold down the cursor wheel and drag | ![Mouse \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036270105) | Pan 3D View > Hold down the right click and drag | ![right click and rotate.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036271129) | Rotate 3D View > Number keys | 🔢 | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036271769) > > * #### **Mac Navigation**
> > > > For details on Mac Navigation, please find the[ attached PDF file](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489152977945). ##### **2) Upload (Version upload)** \- Files can be uploaded on the Content Page to manage versions. File information for each version is available for viewing and download. The following actions are supported: \- version upload \- check version list \- download \- techpack \- rename \- delete ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036272537) ##### **3) Render** \- Rendering functionality is supported to enable more realistic results. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036273305) ##### **4) Comment** \- The Comment feature has been expanded to the content level, allowing comments to be added while reviewing different tabs. Comments can be added to content for communication. Individual users or [Teams](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303212732441) can be tagged using **@** (e.g., @clovirtualfashion). An activity log is also available for review. (_Note: The activity log is only accessible to users with Editor-level permissions or higher._) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051594777) ##### **5) Share** \- Content can be shared by entering an email address. Enter the email address, select a permission (**Editor** or **Viewer**), and click **Share**. The email address does not need to be registered in CLO-SET. \- Users with access to the content can be viewed in the **People with access** section. > _**💡 Notes :**_ The visibility of this option may vary depending on Company Settings.
> > Permission approval can be configured in the Console under **Permission Approval** settings. > If enabled, invitations require approval from a Group Admin before access is granted. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036275097) ##### **6) Open in CLO** \- Content can be opened in CLO for design modifications. **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051604377)** ##### **7) Annotation (Create Annotation / Annotation List)** 7-1) Create Annotation : Annotations can be created to provide precise feedback for garment modifications. **\- View Point Setting Before Creating an Annotation** Before creating an annotation, you can first set the desired viewpoint. This allows feedback to be captured based on the exact screen state and context, improving clarity and accuracy during the review process. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051614617) **\- Add New Marker** A new **Add New Marker** function has been introduced, allowing you to add markers continuously while creating annotations. Multiple annotations can be created without interrupting your workflow, enabling a more seamless review experience. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036287897) **\- Improved Drawing & Editing Tools** The toolbar has been repositioned to the top, ensuring it does not obstruct the Viewer. Additionally, **Text** and **Pen tools** are now supported to provide a more advanced editing experience. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051617561) 7-2) Annotation List : View all annotations for the content. **\- Replies and Nested Replies Visible in the Annotation Pane** Both replies and nested replies are now visible within the Annotation Panel. This makes it easier to follow conversation threads in one place and better understand feedback history and collaboration context. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56493349549977) ##### **8) Configurator** \- The **Configurator** is provided in a new window. After adding a colorway in the Configurator and saving, refresh the original tab to view the newly added colorway. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051618585) ##### **9) Colorway List** \- In the Colorway List, colorway information can be reviewed and the colorway status can be updated. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051619609) ##### **10) Settings / Full Screen** \- Viewer settings—including features such as **Embed View,** **Screenshot** and**Download** —along with a full-screen view option are available in the bottom-right corner of the Viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036293401) #### **4-3) BOM / POM** BOM and POM information for garment content can be viewed directly on the Content Page without navigating to a separate page. Even without a 3D file, BOM and POM can be created and managed as drafts. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036295065)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051622169) #### **4-4) Cost Estimation** Cost estimation information for garment content can be viewed directly on the Content Page without navigating to a separate page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036299033) #### **4-5) Attachment** The Content Page supports attaching various files for the design development process. Files such as images and PDFs can be uploaded using the **Upload File** button in the top-right corner or via drag and drop. You can also click **Add Link** to include reference URLs along with descriptions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051624345)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036303001) #### **4-6) Content Analysis** In **Content Analysis** tab, workflow analysis and activity analysis data of the content can be reviewed. \- **Workflow Analysis Chart** : provides an overview of workflow status changes and lead times for each process step, allowing key metrics to be understood at a glance. \- **Activity Analysis Chart** : visualizes trends in key activity metrics over time using bubble and stacked charts, providing actionable insights. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489051625625) > _**💡 Notes :**_ To use the previous UI (_Legacy Content Page UI_) , click the **Previous Layout** button at the top of the Content Page.
> > To switch back to the new UI, click **Try New Layout** at the top of the Legacy Content Page.
> > The legacy UI will remain available alongside the new experience for a period of time following the March 31, 2026 update.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036306841)
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56489036307481) ### **[Legacy****Content page UI]** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54870708700057) ### ##
